summary: EcoTrack-IA is a proposed AI-driven system aimed at helping small businesses reduce their carbon footprint by providing analytics, recommendations, and tracking tools.
assumptions: Small businesses are willing to adopt AI solutions for sustainability
There is sufficient data available for AI to generate actionable insights
The cost of implementation is affordable for small enterprises
Regulatory or market incentives exist to encourage carbon reduction efforts
gaps: Specific target audience details (industry, size, geography)
Clear definition of the problem being solved
Concrete description of the solution features and technology stack
